_note: SHA-256 of the Linux stable SDK tarball, as Google publishes it in https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/releases_linux.json. This is a lookup table keyed by the pin, NOT a second pin: frontend/.fvmrc alone decides which version is built, and Dockerfile reads it. A version with no row here stops the build and names the row to add, rather than fetching an SDK it cannot verify. Keep old rows — they cost nothing and make a bisect over a version bump buildable.
